summary: Production-ready GitHub Actions matrix generator with correct cartesian expansion and exclude/include semantics. Strengths: proper error handling (Set-StrictMode, exit codes, meaningful messages), pinned actions, least-privilege permissions. Weaknesses: missing array element type validation (array uniqueness, format checks); no debug logging for troubleshooting; workflow validation uses $strategy.matrix.include.Count which needs @(...) wrapping for PowerShell < 5.1 compatibility.
